errors.text_span: Скалата е линейна, с диапазон от 0 до 100, като етикетите са разположени с равномерен интервал от 10 единици (0, 10, 20, ..., 100).
errors.evidence: This sentence describes attributes of the Y-axis (range 0-100) but immediately follows the description of the X-axis, creating confusion. Furthermore, it incorrectly states the interval is 10 units; the Y-axis tick marks are at intervals of 20. The example (0, 10, 20...) also contradicts the stated interval of 10.

errors.evidence: The line for EU-27 shows a clear and steady increase from approximately 65 kg/person in 2010 to 72 kg/person in 2014; it does not stabilize.

errors.text_span: се стабилизира на ниво около 80 кг/човек от 2016 до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The line for EU-27 rises from approximately 80 kg/person in 2016 to 83 kg/person in 2017, then remains at that level in 2018. Describing this entire period as stabilizing at 80 is an oversimplification.
